prompt: ORIGIN: Blender 5.2 Cycles render of a procedural four-panel gold-leaf screen in a dark lacquer room under a sunset lamp; the four light variants differ only in lamp and candle-wall colour and intensity. Rendered at 3840 x 3600 (desktop) and 1560 x 4560 (phone) with a 1 px pixel filter and 512 samples, then downscaled and encoded with sharp YUV. Craft: individually laid gold leaf with overlaps, raised gesso mist bands with gold dust and cut leaf, bevelled lacquer frame, L-shaped brass corner fittings with a punched (nanako) ground, indigo silk mount with gold piping. The frame extends below the screen so the polished floor's full-length reflection can run on under the next section. The figure's shadow is cast by, and projected from, the alpha matte of an owner-supplied profile silhouette that is AI-generated (its C2PA manifest names ChatGPT / gpt-image). The plum tree (tarashikomi wood, Korin-style blossoms), the stream with its gold current lines and eddies, and the mist bands are procedurally painted by script. Pipeline: tools/gold-screen.
